<!-- Generated by apps/docs/scripts/generate-ui-reference.mjs. -->

Place Trigger parts in List and give each a value that matches a Content part. Project Root value and handle valueChange for a controlled tab.

## Usage

```ts
import { tabs, components } from '@viewstem/svelte-ui/shadcn/tabs';
```

The set ID is `shadcn/tabs`. It [registers](../../registration/) 4 components for use in JSON.

### Example View

Register the `tabs` set and pass this JSON as `view` to `renderer.mount`.

```json
{
  "render": {
    "id": "report",
    "componentRef": "shadcn.Tabs.Root",
    "inputs": {
      "value": "summary"
    },
    "slots": {
      "default": [
        {
          "id": "list",
          "componentRef": "shadcn.Tabs.List",
          "slots": {
            "default": [
              {
                "id": "summary",
                "componentRef": "shadcn.Tabs.Trigger",
                "inputs": {
                  "value": "summary",
                  "text": "Summary"
                }
              },
              {
                "id": "activity",
                "componentRef": "shadcn.Tabs.Trigger",
                "inputs": {
                  "value": "activity",
                  "text": "Activity"
                }
              }
            ]
          }
        },
        {
          "id": "summary-panel",
          "componentRef": "shadcn.Tabs.Content",
          "inputs": {
            "value": "summary",
            "text": "Three reports completed"
          }
        },
        {
          "id": "activity-panel",
          "componentRef": "shadcn.Tabs.Content",
          "inputs": {
            "value": "activity",
            "text": "One report created today"
          }
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

“Summary” is selected first. Choose “Activity” to display its panel.

## JSON reference

Inputs without **Required** are optional. In a type, `?` marks an optional object field. **Default** shows a literal default declared by the Svelte wrapper. Other defaults are unspecified here and may come from the underlying component, the browser, or other inputs.

## Native types and composition

In Svelte, use `ComponentProps<typeof components.Root>` for the native prop type. Snippets, function props, DOM refs, and bindings follow the native types.

Namespace type exports `components.TabsListVariant`.

- `components.tabsListVariants` takes options `variant` and optional additional classes, and returns a CSS class string.
